description: 30 strictly held-out claims reserved for blind post-tuning evaluation.

cases.claim: Alphabet Inc. class A shares trade on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol GOOGL

reference.passage: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock (GOOGL) trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Nasdaq listing specification for Alphabet Class A shares.

cases.claim: Alphabet Inc. class A shares trade under the ticker symbol AAPL

reference.passage: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock trades under symbol GOOGL. AAPL is the ticker symbol for Apple Inc.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: AAPL belongs to Apple Inc., not Alphabet.

cases.claim: OpenAI published the research paper introducing the GPT-4 model under arXiv identifier 2303.08774

reference.passage: arXiv:2303.08774 [cs.CL]. Title: GPT-4 Technical Report. Authors: OpenAI. We report the development of GPT-4, a large-scale, multimodal model.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: arXiv 2303.08774 is the official GPT-4 Technical Report preprint.

cases.claim: The GPT-4 Technical Report was published in 1985 before the creation of the World Wide Web

reference.passage: arXiv:2303.08774 submitted on 15 Mar 2023. Authors: OpenAI.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Published March 2023, not 1985.

cases.claim: Microsoft Azure is a cloud computing platform operated by Microsoft

reference.passage: The Azure cloud platform is more than 200 products and cloud services designed to help you bring new solutions to life. Microsoft Azure provides computing, analytics, storage and networking.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Established cloud computing platform operated by Microsoft.

cases.claim: Microsoft Azure is a brand of physical running shoes manufactured from leather by Microsoft

reference.passage: Microsoft Azure is an enterprise cloud computing infrastructure, not footwear or athletic apparel.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Azure is cloud computing software/infrastructure, not physical shoes.

cases.claim: Jensen Huang is the co-founder, President, and Chief Executive Officer of Nvidia

reference.passage: Jensen Huang founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served since its inception as president, chief executive officer, and a member of the board of directors.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official Nvidia leadership documentation.

cases.claim: Jensen Huang was terminated from Nvidia in 1999 and replaced by Bill Gates

reference.passage: Jensen Huang has served continuously since its inception as president, chief executive officer, and a member of the board of directors.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Contradicted by continuous service record.

cases.claim: The Federal Trade Commission sued to block Microsoft's acquisition of Activision Blizzard in December 2022

reference.passage: Dec. 8, 2022 — The Federal Trade Commission today issued an administrative complaint seeking to block technology giant Microsoft Corp. from acquiring leading video game developer Activision Blizzard, Inc.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official FTC administrative action announced December 8, 2022.

cases.claim: The FTC never challenged or reviewed Microsoft's acquisition of Activision Blizzard

reference.passage: The Federal Trade Commission today issued an administrative complaint seeking to block technology giant Microsoft Corp. from acquiring leading video game developer Activision Blizzard, Inc.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by FTC formal administrative complaint and district court litigation.
cases.evidence_limitations: Regulatory denial of documented legal action.

cases.claim: Tesla Cybertruck features an exoskeleton exterior made from ultra-hard 30X cold-rolled stainless steel

reference.passage: Cybertruck is built with an exterior shell made for ultimate durability and passenger protection. Starting with a nearly impenetrable exoskeleton, every component is designed for superior strength and endurance, from Ultra-Hard 30X Cold-Rolled stainless-steel structural skin to Tesla armor glass.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official Tesla product specification material description.

cases.claim: Tesla Cybertruck body panels are manufactured from 100% biodegradable corrugated cardboard

reference.passage: Cybertruck is built with an exterior shell made from Ultra-Hard 30X Cold-Rolled stainless-steel structural skin.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by manufacturing materials: stainless steel, not cardboard.

cases.claim: Apple Inc. was originally incorporated on January 3, 1977 as Apple Computer, Inc.

reference.passage: SEC CIK 0000320193: Apple Inc. State of incorporation: California. Date of incorporation: January 3, 1977. Formerly Apple Computer, Inc.
reference.claim_context: SEC EDGAR Apple Corporate Filing Record

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official SEC EDGAR corporate registration record.

cases.claim: Apple Inc. was incorporated for the first time in December 2025

reference.passage: SEC CIK 0000320193: Apple Inc. Date of incorporation: January 3, 1977.
reference.claim_context: SEC EDGAR Apple Corporate Filing Record

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Contradicts incorporation date by nearly 50 years.

cases.claim: The United States Food and Drug Administration regulates medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and biological products

reference.passage: The Food and Drug Administration is responsible for protecting the public health by ensuring the safety, efficacy, and security of human and veterinary drugs, biological products, and medical devices.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Statutory regulatory authority overview.

cases.claim: The FDA's sole responsibility is regulating the design of submarine torpedoes

reference.passage: The FDA regulates foods, drugs, medical devices, radiation-emitting products, vaccines, cosmetics, and tobacco. It does not regulate military naval munitions.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by statutory jurisdiction.

cases.claim: An unidentified rumor on an unmoderated message board claims an executive secretly bought a diamond mine on Mars
cases.ground_truth_rationale: Zero verifiable evidence, primary filings, or planetary mining assets exist.

cases.claim: A social media user alleges that a commercial airplane was spotted landing on the surface of the sun

reference.passage: The surface temperature of the Sun is approximately 5,500 degrees Celsius (9,932 degrees Fahrenheit). No commercial aircraft or physical human structure can land on the Sun.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by basic astrophysics and thermal limits of materials.

cases.claim: A phishing domain spoofing Bank of America was identified asking users to submit PIN and debit card details

reference.passage: CISA/FBI Alert: Malicious actors frequently establish domain names mimicking major financial institutions (e.g. bankofamerica-security-portal.xyz) to harvest account credentials and payment card PINs.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: CISA security alert describes documented financial phishing vector.

cases.claim: All banking phishing domains are operated directly by official bank tellers during business hours

reference.passage: Phishing websites are registered and hosted by third-party criminal threat actors and cybercrime syndicates seeking unauthorized access, completely unaffiliated with authorized bank personnel.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Phishing infrastructure is operated by criminal threat actors, not official bank staff.

cases.claim: The United States Constitution was signed in Philadelphia in September 1787

reference.passage: The Constitution of the United States: Signed in Convention September 17, 1787 by thirty-nine delegates at Independence Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: National Archives primary historical record.

cases.claim: The United States Constitution was written and signed on the moon in 2020

reference.passage: Signed September 17, 1787 at Independence Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Contradicts date by 233 years and location by astronomical distances.

cases.claim: A customer who received a wrong sneaker size in the mail proves a coordinated international criminal counterfeit conspiracy

reference.passage: Consumer fulfillment errors (such as shipping an incorrect size) are routine retail order fulfillment mistakes, distinguished from organized counterfeit trademark counterfeiting rings.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Fulfillment packaging errors do not substantiate criminal trademark counterfeiting conspiracies.

cases.claim: The official Google Chrome browser web store is hosted on chromewebstore.google.com

reference.passage: Chrome Web Store: Discover extensions and themes to customize Google Chrome.
reference.claim_context: Google Chrome Web Store Official Portal

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official Google web store portal domain.

cases.claim: A website at chrome-malware-download-store.cc offering free pirated movies is an official Google Chrome store

reference.passage: The official Chrome Web Store is hosted under google.com domains. Third-party domains offering pirated media are unauthorized and unaffiliated.
reference.claim_context: Google Chrome Web Store Official Portal

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Unauthorized third-party domain hosting pirated content.

cases.claim: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) maintains the National Vulnerability Database (NVD)

reference.passage: The NVD is the U.S. government repository of standards based vulnerability management data represented using the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) specification, operated by NIST.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official government agency program documentation.

cases.claim: NIST NVD is operated as a secret underground gambling casino in Las Vegas

reference.passage: The NVD is operated by the National Institute of Standards and Technology, a non-regulatory agency of the United States Department of Commerce.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Contradicted by federal statutory mandate.

cases.claim: An anonymous social media rumor claims that a secret portal exists to another dimension beneath a corporate office
cases.ground_truth_rationale: Zero evidence exists for an interdimensional portal in corporate architecture.
cases.evidence_limitations: Fantasy proposition with no verifiable empirical evidence.

cases.claim: The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) published the HTML5 Recommendation in October 2014

reference.passage: 28 October 2014 — Today W3C announced that HTML5 is a completed W3C Recommendation. The specification defines the 5th major version of HTML.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: W3C official press release on October 28, 2014.

cases.claim: HTML5 was originally created by ancient Greek philosophers in 400 BC

reference.passage: HTML5 was developed by the W3C Web Applications and WHATWG working groups in the 21st century and recommended in 2014.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by technological and human history.
